cues.en: Now that you're done with the roads back in the main.py file in the API folder, we're going to group all our routes so you can open the Project Explorer.
cues.zh: 路由完成後，回到 api 資料夾的 main.py，將所有路由集中在一起。先開啟專案檔案總管。

cues.en: Then you're going to go to backend, then app, then API.
cues.zh: 前往 backend/app/api。

cues.en: Then you're going to open this main.py file within API.
cues.zh: 開啟裡面的 main.py。

cues.en: Then at the top we can say from backend dot app, dot api, dot routes dot auth.
cues.zh: 最上方從 backend.app.api.routes.auth，

cues.en: Then you can save the file.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案。

cues.zh: 接著重新建置容器。

cues.en: Since we added new packages which was JWT and some environment variables.
cues.zh: 因為加入了 JWT 套件，以及一些環境變數。

cues.en: So you can go back to the terminal then make sure you're in the root directory.
cues.zh: 回到終端機，確認在根目錄。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Then you can say make build.
cues.zh: 執行 make build。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Once our containers are built, we can always confirm from Docker Desktop that everything is running.
cues.zh: 容器建置完成後，可以到 Docker Desktop 確認都在執行。

cues.en: As you can see, we have these green dots, meaning all the services are running.
cues.zh: 綠點表示所有服務正在執行。

cues.en: We can always confirm the same from our logs.
cues.zh: 也能從日誌確認。

cues.en: So you can just open debug log.
cues.zh: 開啟 debug.log。

cues.en: Then let's scroll to the bottom.
cues.zh: 往下捲。

cues.en: You're going to see.
cues.zh: 會看到，

cues.en: Yes everything seems to be working well then with that, since our services are up and running, we can go to postman.
cues.zh: 沒錯，一切看起來正常。既然服務已啟動，就到 Postman。

cues.en: Then we're going to test the register out by making a Post request to http api dot localhost, then slash api slash v1, then slash auth, then slash register.
cues.zh: 用 POST 測試註冊路由，網址是 http://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/register。

cues.en: Then we're going to have this payload.
cues.zh: 接著傳入這份 payload。

cues.en: So let me see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: The first name can be Mary.
cues.zh: first_name 可以是 Mary。

cues.en: Last name is Jane.
cues.zh: last_name 是 Jane。

cues.en: Then the email let's say can be Mary Jane.
cues.zh: email 可以是 Mary Jane 的地址。

cues.en: Then that's the ID number.
cues.zh: 這裡是身分證明號碼。

cues.en: Then let's try making the request without the passwords matching and see if we get the error.
cues.zh: 先試試兩次密碼不同，看看是否出錯。

cues.en: So let's say the password is 1234567.
cues.zh: 例如 password 是 1234567，

cues.en: Then confirm password is a different password.
cues.zh: confirm_password 則是不同密碼。

cues.en: Make the request good.
cues.zh: 發出請求，很好。

cues.en: You're going to see we have a 400 bad request.
cues.zh: 得到 400 Bad Request。

cues.en: And then we have the detail with the status being error.
cues.zh: detail 裡的 status 是 error。

cues.en: Then the message passwords don't match.
cues.zh: message 是「兩次密碼不相同」。

cues.en: much, then the action is.
cues.zh: 再來 action 是，

cues.en: Please ensure that the passwords you entered much.
cues.zh: 「請確認輸入的密碼相同」。

cues.en: So as you can see, these are the response details that we've been working on in our roots.
cues.zh: 這就是路由裡定義的回應詳細資訊。

cues.en: So for example, if we check the activator out when you're talking about detail with the status message and the action.
cues.zh: 例如 activate 路由裡的 detail，包括 status、message 與 action，

cues.en: So this is how those exceptions are going to be displayed on postman.
cues.zh: 在 Postman 會這樣顯示。

cues.en: Then let's now make the request with the right password.
cues.zh: 接著用正確密碼發送請求。

cues.en: So let's say the password is six.
cues.zh: 這裡講者說，密碼是 6。

cues.en: Then the confirm password is the same.
cues.zh: confirm_password 使用相同值。

cues.en: Let's make the request good.
cues.zh: 發出請求，很好。

cues.en: As you can see we get a 201 created response with this response.
cues.zh: 得到 201 Created，以及這個回應。

cues.en: And as you can see the username is automatically generated from our utility function as we had specified.
cues.zh: 使用者名稱已透過工具函式，自動產生。

cues.en: Then we get all these as part of the user response.
cues.zh: 使用者回應包含這些資料。

cues.en: And as you can see is active is set to false because the user hasn't activated the account yet.
cues.zh: is_active 是 False，因為使用者還沒啟用帳戶。

cues.en: Now if you go back to flower in your browser then let me login.
cues.zh: 接著在瀏覽器前往 Flower，先登入。

cues.en: The username is admin and I think the password was pass 123456.
cues.zh: 使用者是 admin，密碼應該是 pass123456。

cues.en: If you go under tasks, you're going to see that the send email task was successful.
cues.zh: 到 Tasks，會看到 send_email_task 成功執行。

cues.en: And now if you go to Milpitas on localhost 8025, you can see that we have this activate your account email.
cues.zh: 再到 localhost:8025 的 Mailpit，可以看到「啟用你的帳戶」郵件。

cues.en: As you can see, it was sent to Mary Jane.
cues.zh: 收件者是 Mary Jane。

cues.en: And we have the HTML version of the email.
cues.zh: 這裡是 HTML 版本。

cues.en: And if you click on text we also have the text version of the email.
cues.zh: 點 Text，也有純文字版本。

cues.en: So it means our email templates are being rendered correctly.
cues.zh: 表示郵件範本已正確呈現。

cues.en: So you can go back to the HTML version of the email.
cues.zh: 回到 HTML 版本。

cues.en: Then before you can click on the activate account button, let's inspect our database.
cues.zh: 按啟用按鈕之前，先檢查資料庫。

cues.en: As I said before, you can use the terminal.
cues.zh: 之前說過，可以用終端機，

cues.en: As I shown you.
cues.zh: 就像我示範的。

cues.en: You can use data grip, you can use Pgadmin or on macOS, you can also use a tool called Tableau plus.
cues.zh: 也能用 DataGrip、pgAdmin，或 macOS 的 TablePlus。

cues.en: That's what I'm going to use.
cues.zh: 我會用 TablePlus。

cues.en: If you're using Tableau Plus you can click on Create Connection.
cues.zh: 如果使用 TablePlus，按 Create Connection。

cues.en: Then it's a Postgres database, then click on create.
cues.zh: 選 Postgres，再按 Create。

cues.en: Then for Postgres connection.
cues.zh: 設定 Postgres 連線。

cues.en: Let me see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: I can name this next gen bank like that.
cues.zh: 名稱可以叫 NextGen Bank。

cues.en: Then the port is 5432, then the username was alpha or gilo.
cues.zh: 連接埠是 5432；使用者名稱這裡口述為 alpha／gilo。

cues.en: Then the password was pass 123456.
cues.zh: 密碼是 pass123456。

cues.en: Then for the database name let me confirm.
cues.zh: 資料庫名稱，再確認一下。

cues.en: I can open the dot env dot local file and then let me see Postgres databases next gen just like that.
cues.zh: 開啟 .env.local，可以看到 POSTGRES_DB 是 nextgen。

cues.en: So I They can come here to Turbo+, then add next gen.
cues.zh: 所以回到 TablePlus，填入 nextgen。

cues.en: And this process is the same as in Pgadmin or when you're using any other tools such as data grip.
cues.zh: 這個流程和 pgAdmin 或 DataGrip 等工具相同。

cues.en: Then let me see.
cues.zh: 再看看。

cues.en: Let me test the connection and see if it connects.
cues.zh: 測試連線是否成功。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: It seems to have connected so I can just click on connect.
cues.zh: 似乎連上了，按 Connect。

cues.en: Then as you can see from my tables here I have the Alembic table and the user table.
cues.zh: 資料表清單裡有 Alembic 與 user。

cues.en: If I click on the user table to inspect the data, we can see right here that the user was created.
cues.zh: 點 user 查看資料，可以看到使用者已建立。

cues.en: And let's also confirm that the password was hashed.
cues.zh: 再確認密碼有經過雜湊。

cues.en: So you can just scroll to the left.
cues.zh: 向左捲，

cues.en: We're going to see that the password was also hashed.
cues.zh: 可以看到密碼確實已雜湊。

cues.en: And in the meantime this account has an account status of pending because we haven't activated the account yet.
cues.zh: 目前帳戶狀態是 pending，因為尚未啟用。

cues.en: So the status is pending and is active should also be set to false like that.
cues.zh: 所以 account_status 是 pending，is_active 也應該是 False。

cues.en: So make sure you can see this in your database.
cues.zh: 確認資料庫裡有這些資料。

cues.en: Then now that you've tested this out before we can click on this activate button.
cues.zh: 測試後，先別按啟用按鈕。

cues.en: Again.
cues.zh: 再來，

cues.en: Let's assume due to some reason the user requests for another activation email.
cues.zh: 假設使用者因某種原因，要求重新寄送啟用郵件。

cues.en: To do this, let's make another Post request on postman so you can go back to postman.
cues.zh: 到 Postman 再發出 POST。

cues.en: We're going to make a post request to api dot localhost, then slash api slash v1.
cues.zh: 網址是 api.localhost/api/v1，

cues.en: A slash auth slash resend activation link with the user's email.
cues.zh: 再接 /auth/resend-activation-link，傳入使用者 email。

cues.en: So let me try this user who doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 先用不存在的使用者測試。

cues.en: If I do that, I'm going to be told that status is an error.
cues.zh: 發出請求，status 是 error。

cues.en: So this email doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 表示這個 email 不存在。

cues.en: So let's try with the email that exists, which is Mary Jane.
cues.zh: 再用存在的 Mary Jane 地址。

cues.en: As you can just see here Mary dot Jane at gmail.com send.
cues.zh: 輸入 mary.jane@gmail.com，再按 Send。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: We get a 200 okay status code and the successful message.
cues.zh: 得到 200 OK 與成功訊息。

cues.en: Now if you go back to Mail Pit, you're going to see that we have another email to activate our account, both the HTML and the text version, meaning everything is working as expected.
cues.zh: 回到 Mailpit，會看到另一封啟用郵件，同樣有 HTML 與純文字版本，表示一切正常。

cues.en: And then now to activate our account we can click on this activate button.
cues.zh: 接著可以按啟用按鈕。

cues.en: Or you can copy this URL that has the token both work.
cues.zh: 或複製含有 token 的 URL，兩種都可以。

cues.en: So I can test it by just clicking on the Activate account button.
cues.zh: 我直接按 Activate account 測試。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: You're going to get a message stating that the account has been activated successfully.
cues.zh: 得到帳戶已成功啟用的訊息。

cues.en: Now if you go back to Table Plus, then let's refresh our workspace.
cues.zh: 回到 TablePlus，重新整理工作區。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: We're now going to see that the Mary Jane user has the is active is now set to true.
cues.zh: Mary Jane 的 is_active 已設為 True。

cues.en: Then the account status is now active.
cues.zh: account_status 也變成 active。

cues.en: It's no longer pending meaning our activation works good.
cues.zh: 不再是 pending，表示啟用功能正常。

cues.en: Then if you are to wait for this activation link to expire, which in our case it expires after two minutes, you'll get the corresponding error message and the activation would fail.
cues.zh: 若等到啟用連結到期，這裡是兩分鐘，會得到對應錯誤，啟用失敗。

cues.en: Also, if you try activating the user again.
cues.zh: 另外，如果再次啟用同一個使用者，

cues.en: So let's try activating the user again.
cues.zh: 來試試，

cues.en: We're going to have this error stating that the user has already been activated.
cues.zh: 會看到使用者已啟用的錯誤。

cues.en: Then if you also try resending the activation email link to a user who has already been activated, you should get an error message.
cues.zh: 若對已啟用的使用者重新寄送啟用連結，也應該出錯。

cues.en: Let's test that on postman.
cues.zh: 到 Postman 測試。

cues.en: So you can go to postman then let's try resending the activation email link again to Mary Jane who has her account already activated.
cues.zh: 再次要求寄送給 Mary Jane，她的帳戶已啟用。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: You get the error stating that this user account has already been activated.
cues.zh: 錯誤表示這個使用者帳戶已啟用。

cues.en: So it seems that our user registration and activation is working as intended.
cues.zh: 所以使用者註冊與啟用都符合預期。

cues.en: Then one last thing is we can test the expiry of the token.
cues.zh: 最後可以測試權杖到期。

cues.en: Remember this.
cues.zh: 記得這個，

cues.en: Activate account.
cues.zh: 帳戶啟用，

cues.en: Token expires after two minutes.
cues.zh: 權杖會在兩分鐘後到期。

cues.en: So if we try activating our account again despite the user being activated, we should also get an error stating that our token has expired.
cues.zh: 即使使用者已啟用，現在再次使用過期權杖，也應得到權杖到期錯誤。

cues.en: So this time, instead of clicking the link, let me just copy this link.
cues.zh: 這次不按按鈕，直接複製連結。

cues.en: Paste it.
cues.zh: 貼上。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Activation token has expanded, which is correct.
cues.zh: 訊息是啟用權杖已到期，正確。

cues.en: If you click on the button instead, you still get the same error.
cues.zh: 按按鈕也會得到同樣錯誤。

cues.en: So it seems things are working as expected.
cues.zh: 看起來符合預期。

cues.en: Now we can commit our code as you can go to a git client on VSCode.
cues.zh: 現在可以提交程式碼，到 VS Code 的 Git 用戶端。

cues.en: Then let's say this is a feature and you can see user can register and activate the account.
cues.zh: 類型是 feat，訊息是 user can register and activate account。

cues.en: Then we can make the commit.
cues.zh: 再提交。

cues.en: With that done let's bring down our containers because in the next lecture we're going to be adding new environment variables.
cues.zh: 接著停止並移除容器，因為下一堂課要加入新環境變數。

cues.en: And as I said before, new packages and environment variables are loaded in our containers at build time and runtime.
cues.zh: 依講者這裡的說明，新套件與環境變數是在建置時、執行時載入容器。

cues.en: That's why we need to bring down our containers and build them again whenever we add new environment variables or packages.
cues.zh: 所以新增環境變數或套件後，要移除容器並重新建置。

cues.en: So let's go back to the terminal.
cues.zh: 回到終端機。

cues.en: Then we can see here make done good.
cues.zh: 執行 make down，很好。
